bindingRefreshHint: Refresh clears unsaved recipient, channel-label and URL drafts without changing stored settings.
bindingConfirmationUnavailable: The binding save was acknowledged, but recipient and delivery preferences could not be confirmed by readback. Refresh before relying on them.
readStale: Refresh failed. Displayed data is from the last successful read; retry before relying on its current status.
readUnavailable: This information could not be read. Retry without changing configuration.
bindingUnavailable: Saved binding metadata is unavailable, not necessarily unconfigured.
preferenceSaved: Channel preferences confirmed by readback. This is not a delivery test.
preferenceFailed: Preferences could not be confirmed. The last confirmed selection has been restored; refresh before retrying.
minimumSelection: Keep at least one delivery target and one saved channel selected.
clipboardFailed: Clipboard unavailable. The URL was not copied.
recipientDraft: Recipient changes are drafts until saved and confirmed.
recipientInvalid: Enter a complete email address before saving the recipient or binding.
ocrLoadFailed: OCR status could not be read. Retry without changing the policy or requesting a plan.
resultHandles.label: Follow-up questions over earlier answers
resultHandles.hint: Keep the rows of each answered list so a follow-up such as only the running ones refers to what was shown. Core stores them encrypted and expires them. Development environments default on; other environments default off. This setting never grants action authority. Changes apply after a restart.
forecastHistory.collectionHint: Use the audited Settings preference to collect reviewed histories. Deployment variables cannot enable it. Missing source completeness or independent proofs still prevent scoring; this never grants execution authority.
forecastHistory.boundary: A bound reader is not a completeness proof. Missing checkpoints or independent proofs keep forecast scoring unavailable.
forecastHistory.checkpointPresent: Positive checkpoint reported by the source
accountStepHint: Your FDAI identity and Microsoft 365 workflow identity can belong to different tenants. Keep the workflow owner account ready for Microsoft account selection.
accountUsageHint: This value is for copying only. It does not control Microsoft sign-in or infer the tenant, and FDAI does not store it.
accountInvalid: Enter a complete email-style user principal name.
workflowStep: Create or open the workflow in Power Automate
workflowStepHint: Power Automate uses the current Microsoft browser session. If it is not the account above, switch or sign out there, or open the link in a private browser window.
saveBoundary: A deployment stores the URL in a dedicated Key Vault secret. The local profile stores only encrypted ciphertext in its private Operator database. FDAI verifies the exact saved version before testing. Authorized reveals are audited without storing the URL in the audit record. Saving and testing do not activate runtime delivery.
a1OnboardingDescription: FDAI prepares repeatable infrastructure through protected deployment. Microsoft tenant consent and the final production change remain explicit human approvals.
a1AutomatedBot: Prepare the Azure Bot, Teams channel, and dedicated non-executor identity through the protected deployment you review.
a1AutomatedSso: Prepare the approved SSO client trust, redirect, and Teams app package in the same protected deployment.
a1AutomatedDeployment: Generate guarded Core and Operator plans, then verify readiness and the approval round trip before any change applies.
a1HumanOauth: In Azure, approve the OAuth connection or tenant consent when your organization requires it.
a1HumanInstall: In Teams Admin Center, approve the FDAI app and install it in the intended approval team and channel.
a1HumanApproval: Approve the protected deployment after reviewing the exact plan and identity changes.
a1SecretBoundary: Never paste a client secret into FDAI Console. Enter provider credentials only in the Microsoft-hosted authorization screen.
a1RequestHint: Creates an audited, no-authority request for the protected deployment runner. No Azure or Teams change happens until the plan is reviewed.
a1RequestedHint: The request is recorded. Complete the provider approvals below while FDAI prepares the guarded deployment plan.
saveTestStepHint: Paste the generated HTTP URL from Power Automate. FDAI saves and independently verifies a new binding version, then sends the bounded test card. The saved URL is shown masked by default; Contributor, Approver, and Owner roles can reveal or copy it through an audited read. Only an Owner can replace it.
bindingHidden: The saved URL is hidden for this role.
bindingMissing: No saved Teams Workflows URL is available. An Owner can save one.
contributorReadOnly: Masked by default for Contributor, Approver, and Owner roles. Use the view or copy controls to inspect the saved URL; only an Owner can replace and test it.
bindingNeverReturned: The saved URL stays masked until revealed by a Contributor, Approver, or Owner. Keep the current binding or paste a new URL to replace it.
channelSelectionTitle: Notification channels to use (single or simultaneous multi-channel)
channelSelectionHint: Check one channel to deliver to a single destination, or check multiple channels to fan out notifications simultaneously.
target.teams-a2-operational-alert.label: A2 operational alert channel
target.teams-a2-operational-alert.hint: Immediate incident and runtime alert cards
target.teams-a4-digest.label: A4 scheduled digest channel
target.teams-a4-digest.hint: Daily and weekly governance summary digests
target.slack-webhook.label: Slack incoming webhook channel
target.email.label: Email delivery channel
target.email.hint: Simultaneous on-call and governance email delivery
target.console-inbox.label: Console web inbox channel
target.console-inbox.hint: Record alerts in the Console notification inbox
savedTeamsChannelsHint: Select one or multiple Teams channel webhooks to use simultaneously. Paste a new URL above to add another Teams channel.
channelLabelInput: Channel name (optional, for adding a new URL)
emailRecipientHint: Choose whether email notifications use the signed-in account email or a separate custom email address.
opEvidence.agent-discussion-read.label: Operational evidence: Agent discussion read
opEvidence.agent-discussion-read.hint: Independent verifier admission for multi-agent discussion read sessions.
opEvidence.case-history-read.label: Operational evidence: Case history read
opEvidence.case-history-read.hint: Verified readback of historical incident and operational case records.
opEvidence.current-case-reuse.label: Operational evidence: Current case reuse
opEvidence.current-case-reuse.hint: Eligibility proof for reusing verified patterns on active operational cases.
opEvidence.forecast-context.label: Operational evidence: Forecast context
opEvidence.forecast-context.hint: Context completeness verification before capacity and risk forecasting.
opEvidence.forecast-history-actions.hint: Independent proof for action-audit history used in forecast evaluation.
opEvidence.forecast-history-changes.hint: Independent proof for external change history used in forecast evaluation.
opEvidence.forecast-history-excluded_win: Independent proof for maintenance and excluded time windows in forecasting.
opEvidence.forecast-history-resource_lif: Independent proof for resource creation and retirement history in forecasting.
opEvidence.operational-test-context.hint: Source-bound test-context verification before runtime admission.
Independent observation proof for bounded operational test executions.
opEvidence.operator-test-context-command: Principal authentication and grant verification for test-context commands.
opEvidence.test-context-transition.label: Operational evidence: Test-context state transition
opEvidence.test-context-transition.hint: Independent proof for test-context lifecycle transitions and revocations.
bindingSavedDetail: Version {version} was saved and verified at {time}. Saving is not activation; a deployment still decides when A2 delivery uses this binding.
bindingSavedVersionOnly: Version {version} is saved. FDAI has no local save record for this version, and saving is not activation.
groupApprovalsHint: Authenticated, action-bound approval delivery and callback. A notification webhook can never satisfy this path.
groupNotificationsHint: Outbound-only delivery. Saving or testing an endpoint does not activate runtime delivery; a deployment activates a binding explicitly.
personalChannelsDescription: Choose how the signed-in user receives personal FDAI alerts in this browser. Organization delivery routes are configured separately below.
consoleWebPersonalHint: Applies to {user} in this browser profile. It receives runtime-observed approval, denial, and failure alerts. Organization Teams, Slack, and email routes below are unchanged.
groupConversationsHint: Bidirectional chat commands owned by the Operator conversation channel edge.
groupOtherHint: Change delivery, ticketing, and access review configuration observed by this runtime.
teamsA1SendHint: Core Bot delivery of approval cards to the configured group-connected team and channel. Teams Workflows webhooks can never carry A1 approvals.
teamsA1CallbackHint: Operator verification of a returned approval decision. Partial configuration leaves approvals unavailable rather than degraded.
teamsA2Hint: Teams Workflows binding activated for outbound operational alerts. Saving or testing a URL does not activate delivery.
teamsA4Hint: Teams Workflows binding activated for scheduled digests. Digest rooms never receive A2 paging traffic.
teamsA3Hint: Operator-owned conversation channel edge. It shares Teams credentials with approvals but keeps a separate blast radius.
savedAndAcceptedDetail: The saved binding version was verified, then Power Automate accepted the test with HTTP {status} at {time}.
guideSummary: Show the Power Automate setup guide
guideIntro: Complete the following steps in Power Automate before pasting the callback URL into FDAI.
guideVerifyAccountBody: Open the account manager in the upper-right corner and confirm that the signed-in account matches:
guideCreateBody: In the left navigation, select Create. Under Start from blank, select Automated cloud flow.
guideCreateImageAlt: Power Automate with Create and the Automated cloud flow tile highlighted
guideCreateImageCaption: Select Create, then Automated cloud flow.
guideNameFlowTitle: Name the flow and skip trigger selection
guideNameFlowBody: Enter a recognizable Flow name, such as FDAI Teams Flow. Do not select a trigger in this dialog. Select Skip to open the flow designer.
guideNameFlowImageAlt: Build an automated cloud flow dialog with FDAI Teams Flow entered and Skip highlighted
guideNameFlowImageCaption: Enter the Flow name, then select Skip.
guideAddTriggerBody: In the flow designer, select Add a trigger.
guideAddTriggerImageAlt: Power Automate flow designer with Add a trigger highlighted
guideSelectTriggerTitle: Select the Microsoft Teams Webhook trigger
guideSelectTriggerBody: Select Microsoft Teams Webhook, then select When a Teams webhook request is received.
guideSelectTriggerImageAlt: Microsoft Teams Webhook trigger list showing When a Teams webhook request is received
guideSelectTriggerImageCaption: Select When a Teams webhook request is received.
guideConfigureTriggerBody: On Parameters, set Who can trigger the flow? to Anyone. The HTTP URL is generated only after the flow is saved. Anyone who has that URL can trigger the flow, so keep it secret and apply your tenant's workflow policy.
guideConfigureTriggerImageAlt: Teams webhook trigger parameters with Who can trigger the flow set to Anyone and an HTTP URL generated after save
guideConfigureTriggerImageCaption: Set Who can trigger the flow? to Anyone. The HTTP URL appears after save.
guideAddActionBody: Under the webhook trigger, select + to add an action. Select Microsoft Teams, then select Post card in a chat or channel.
guideAddActionImageAlt: Plus button highlighted below the Teams webhook trigger
guideAddActionImageCaption: Select + below the trigger to add a new action.
guideConfigureActionTitle: Configure the Teams destination and card
guideConfigureActionBody: Set Post as to Flow bot and Post in to Channel. Select the target Team and Channel. In Adaptive Card, insert the triggerBody() expression. The Team and Channel shown below are illustrative; select the actual notification destination.
guideConfigureActionImageAlt: Post card in a chat or channel action configured for Flow bot, Channel, a target Team and Channel, and the triggerBody expression
guideConfigureActionImageCaption: Select the target Team and Channel, then set Adaptive Card to triggerBody().
guideFinishTitle: Confirm the Flow name and save
guideFinishBody: Select the flow title at the top and confirm that the Flow name is the intended name. Update it if needed, then select Save in the upper-right corner.
guideFinishImageAlt: Power Automate command bar with the Save button highlighted
guideFinishImageCaption: Select Save in the upper-right corner.
guideCopyUrlBody: After the save succeeds, select When a Teams webhook request is received. Under Parameters, copy the generated HTTP URL and return to FDAI.
guideCopyUrlImageAlt: Saved Power Automate flow showing its title, the Teams webhook trigger, and the copy control beside a redacted HTTP URL
guideCopyUrlImageCaption: Confirm the Flow name, open the trigger, and copy the generated HTTP URL. The URL is redacted in this guide.
guideSecretNote: Treat the callback URL as a secret. Do not place it in source control, documentation, chat, or screenshots.
ocrSubtitle: Choose local OCR or request protected Azure provisioning.
ocrLocalBody: Process-isolated Korean and English Tesseract; no Azure transfer or charge.
ocrAzureBody: Managed identity and private networking; plan and apply approval required.
ocrApprovalBoundary: Saving only requests a protected plan. Apply requires separate approval.
ocrPlanRequested: The protected OCR infrastructure plan was requested.
ocrEnvironmentUnavailable: The active deployment environment is unavailable.
